device.modelDescription: Step module of the ch-packs family: cleans one GitHub Actions job log into its steps, so later steps see the output a person would read and nothing else. A pure function of its input: no disk, no network, no state.

actionList.name: clean
actionList.description: Cleans one GitHub Actions job log, as the logs endpoint returns it, into steps. Strips the byte-order mark, the timestamp on every line, ANSI escapes (colours, hyperlinks, character sets), group markers, progress lines (a bare percentage, git's object and delta counters) and blank lines; keeps ##[error] and ##[warning] lines with their marker. A step starts at its '##[group]Run <command>' header (the runner's, which echoes the command, lists a uses: step's inputs, or is empty; not a group a script opens) and is named after it; the header's own lines are dropped; post steps start at 'Post job cleanup.'; lines before the first step are the step '(top)'. Returns the steps in order, how many lines the log had and how many were kept.
